title: bbox_blame presents a different file's edit as the bbox anchor when no same-file anchor exists
wanted_capability: bbox_blame attributes a line only to an EDITED_FILE anchor whose anchor.file_path matches the blamed file. When the blamed commit has anchors only for other files, the response either reports no matching anchor or labels the result as a same-commit, different-file candidate, instead of presenting it as the line's anchor.
evidence: crates/bbox-mcp-tools/src/mcp_tools/blame.rs matching_anchors: exact file_path matches are preferred, but when none exist the whole same-commit set is returned and anchors.first() becomes the selected anchor
crates/bbox-mcp-tools/src/mcp_tools/blame.rs render_text / render_anchor: the selected edge is printed as 'bbox anchor' with no indication that its anchor.file_path differs from git_blame.rel_path
crates/bbox-edge-index/src/edge_index.rs commit_anchor_index: keyed only by anchor.commit_sha_at_edit on EDITED_FILE edges
crates/bbox-mcp-tools/src/mcp_tools/blame.rs test matching_anchors_prefers_same_file covers the exact-match case only
notes: Triage trace: exact file_path preference in matching_anchors already exists, so the original 'always returns the first anchor' description no longer holds. The problem that remains is the fallback: with no same-file anchor for the blamed commit, an anchor from another file is selected, and it drives prior_reads, session, brofiles, and threads with no mismatch signal.
